canonicalCopy.authority: The About JSX remains the canonical public copy. This registry maps its displayed chapters and actions to operating truth; it does not replace or rewrite the copy.

chapters.name: Scout
chapters.summary: Understand a need, compare options, and prepare the next action.

chapters.name: Direct Connect
chapters.summary: Control the request, preview, acceptance, contact, and outcome.

chapters.name: Business home
chapters.summary: Replace the website stack and use tools built for the business type.

chapters.name: Home & property
chapters.summary: Keep HomeID, HomeScout, work, inspections, and selling connected.

chapters.name: Exchange
chapters.summary: Browse, list, request, buy, sell, rent, promote, and track the outcome.

chapters.name: Money
chapters.summary: See what stays free, how revenue works, and what businesses may choose to buy.

chapters.name: Community
chapters.summary: Follow vaults, scholarships, jobs, helpers, veterans, and local reinvestment.

chapters.name: CVS
chapters.summary: Understand what affects Community Verification Score and eligibility.

chapters.name: Every feature
chapters.summary: Open the complete action-based feature inventory.

direct-connect.accountableRole: TradeScout operations and Direct Connect engineering

about-copy.note: Canonical public wording only; it is not implementation or production proof.

app-routes.note: A routed surface is evidence of reachability only.

direct-connect-lifecycle-test.note: Test presence is not a claim that it currently passes in production.

profile-catalog-exchange-source.note: Exactly one request-only Exchange spotlight for JW Stone LLC and one for ISSA Build; profile catalogs remain authoritative.

jw-old-site-sheet-contract.note: Applies only to old-site additions. Existing current inventory is a read-only baseline and remains unchanged.

actions.action: Ask what to do next
actions.statusReason: Scout has governed command and behavior registries, but this contract has no timestamped production proof for the complete public promise.
actions.gap: Prove ordinary-language intent through a correct, actionable next step in production.

actions.action: Check safety, codes, permits, and inspection steps
actions.statusReason: The public boundary and Scout action surface exist without current production proof of sourced, correctly bounded local guidance.
actions.gap: Prove source attribution, uncertainty handling, and safe handoff for a real county path.

actions.action: See who people support or warn against
actions.statusReason: Recommendation and Community surfaces exist, but no timestamped production evidence is attached here.
actions.gap: Prove positive and negative recommendation context, comments, and moderation end to end.

actions.action: Follow what is happening nearby
actions.statusReason: The current recovery audit found Community threads, tags, identity links, notifications, and moderation do not flow coherently.
actions.gap: Establish one canonical Community record and route spine before claiming the nearby activity loop works.

actions.action: Turn information into a next step
actions.statusReason: Decision/action structures exist, but this registry has no current production proof of the promised information-to-action handoff.
actions.gap: Prove the recommended action, explanation, review, and correct destination as one journey.

actions.action: Compare the business behind the offer
actions.statusReason: Public business profiles and contract tests exist without contract-linked production proof for every displayed claim.
actions.gap: Prove offer, service area, controller, and evidence visibility on a live profile.

actions.action: Understand why an account appears
actions.statusReason: CVS contract coverage exists, but the public explanation-to-runtime eligibility mapping is not proven here.
actions.gap: Prove a live account's displayed explanation matches the signals and eligibility actually used.

actions.action: See activity and service coverage
actions.statusReason: A map surface exists, but no timestamped production coverage proof is recorded.
actions.gap: Prove current businesses, listings, offers, and local activity render for a real county.

actions.action: See who is contributing locally
actions.statusReason: The leaderboard surface exists without current proof that ordering is complete, current, and independent of payment.
actions.gap: Prove contribution ordering and the no-pay-to-play invariant with live evidence.

actions.action: Browse organized local results
actions.statusReason: Directory routes and profile contracts exist without a current production journey attached to this action.
actions.gap: Prove location retention, category navigation, and correct profile destinations.

actions.action: Search local help with more filters
actions.statusReason: The advanced-search surface is routed, but filter accuracy and live-result continuity are not proven here.
actions.gap: Prove place, service, and evidence filters against current production data.

actions.action: Find verified people nearby
actions.statusReason: People-discovery and trust surfaces exist without production proof of the complete profile-to-controlled-connection path.
actions.gap: Prove nearby discovery, profile navigation, and gated request or connection behavior.

actions.action: Follow people and keep local relationships
actions.statusReason: Connection and follow surfaces exist, but their identity and notification continuity is not production-proven here.
actions.gap: Prove follow state, clickable identity, and separation from Direct Connect authority.

actions.action: Compare common cost factors
actions.statusReason: Calculator and finance surfaces exist without current evidence that all advertised calculators are accurate and bounded.
actions.gap: Validate calculations, disclosures, and destination continuity for each supported calculator.

actions.action: Find urgent local help
actions.statusReason: The business directory can be reached, but the urgent-help narrowing and safety boundary are not production-proven here.
actions.gap: Prove time-sensitive filtering without implying emergency-service guarantees.

actions.action: Find partner offers for active needs
actions.statusReason: Exchange and offer surfaces exist without proof that active needs receive relevant, correctly labeled partner offers.
actions.gap: Prove relevance, disclosure, and no-trust-purchase boundaries in production.

actions.action: Buy, sell, or rent locally
actions.statusReason: Exchange discovery and category routing exist, including two request-only business catalog spotlights, but the full listing-to-outcome lifecycle is not proven here.
actions.gap: Prove a JW Stone or ISSA Build catalog spotlight through the managed request path and an explicit terminal outcome.

actions.action: Install TradeScout on the device
actions.statusReason: An install route exists without timestamped cross-device production proof.
actions.gap: Prove supported installation and account continuity on current mobile and desktop targets.

actions.action: Turn a need into a trackable request
actions.statusReason: Request creation machinery exists, but the current audit found lifecycle visibility and downstream continuity gaps.
actions.gap: Prove one request retains recipients, decisions, progress, and operator visibility.

actions.action: Send it only to businesses you choose
actions.statusReason: The advertised Direct Connect lifecycle is not reliable across recipient selection, admin access, conversation, and delivery.
actions.gap: Complete the queued Connection recovery and prove requester, business, admin, and superadmin continuity.

actions.action: Keep the conversation with the request
actions.statusReason: Current message routing can resolve outside the exact Direct Connect request and assignment.
actions.gap: Bind one canonical conversation to the case, request, assignment, and acting business identity.

actions.action: Search prior conversations
actions.statusReason: Conversation identity is not yet reliably request-specific, so search cannot truthfully guarantee the correct thread.
actions.gap: Canonicalize conversation identity before proving search by person, business, request, and message.

actions.action: See what changed without checking every tool
actions.statusReason: In-app, push, and email delivery use disconnected paths, and the JW Stone request produced no durable email outcome.
actions.gap: Create one durable delivery ledger with exact destinations and queued, sent, delivered, failed, or suppressed truth.

actions.action: Return to people who approved contact
actions.statusReason: A connections route exists, but relationship and request identity continuity are not proven here.
actions.gap: Prove approved direct contacts remain distinct from followers, strangers, and business request authority.

actions.action: Check identity and business proof
actions.statusReason: Verification and profile contracts exist without a current end-to-end production proof packet.
actions.gap: Prove action-specific identity and business evidence rather than a generic badge.

actions.action: Complete extra screening when the role requires it
actions.statusReason: The About copy says background-check intake exists while the portable Screen Pass and partner completion are unfinished.
actions.gap: Finish and prove the portable result without exposing the private report.

actions.action: Establish who controls something
actions.statusReason: Business claim paths exist, but business, profile, property, and asset authority are not all production-proven here.
actions.gap: Prove each supported claim type and its privileged-action enforcement.

actions.action: Sell a defined service or item
actions.statusReason: Business offer surfaces exist without a current production proof from published scope to guided request or purchase.
actions.gap: Prove scope, price, availability, and the correct inquiry or purchase handoff.

actions.action: Let customers request a time
actions.statusReason: Booking implementation exists, but free-request and disclosed-deposit paths lack contract-linked production proof.
actions.gap: Prove availability, request state, business response, and payment boundary.

actions.action: Complete a disclosed payment
actions.statusReason: Payment and accounting implementation anchors exist without timestamped production proof for an eligible purchase or work step.
actions.gap: Prove signature-safe payment completion, idempotency, history, and case linkage.

actions.action: Post a job or a resume
actions.statusReason: The About copy explicitly says complete applicant tracking is still being built.
actions.gap: Prove job posting, resume posting, application, review, and terminal applicant state.

actions.action: Find help for ordinary work
actions.statusReason: Helper and Direct Connect implementation paths exist without a production-proven ordinary-work journey.
actions.gap: Prove skills, location, availability, request, acceptance, and safe contact.

actions.action: Coordinate a shared place
actions.statusReason: The current Community audit found group payload and membership or private-group authorization gaps.
actions.gap: Repair canonical group data, membership authority, and shared-place workflow continuity.

actions.action: Publish and follow a local event
actions.statusReason: Community identity, tags, routes, and notifications are not coherent enough to prove event follow-through.
actions.gap: Prove event creation, discovery, author identity, following, and exact notification destinations.

actions.action: Report harmful or misleading activity
actions.statusReason: The current audit found the superadmin moderation view does not provide a truthful actionable queue.
actions.gap: Unify reports, moderation state, exact content destinations, decisions, and audit history.

actions.action: Request a mobile or remote notarization
actions.statusReason: Notary routes exist without current production proof of request completion and legal-boundary presentation.
actions.gap: Prove request intake, service distinction, availability, and required disclosures.

actions.action: Track the assets you care for
actions.statusReason: Asset and HomeID surfaces exist without current production proof for complete inspection, maintenance, upgrade, and document history.
actions.gap: Prove a real asset history survives navigation and later action.

actions.action: Preserve a property history
actions.statusReason: HomeID and completed-work enrichment contracts exist without a current production golden case.
actions.gap: Prove components, service, ownership context, documents, and verified outcomes persist.

actions.action: Publish or follow a property listing
actions.statusReason: HomeScout and Exchange property surfaces exist without a proven listing-to-later-record lifecycle.
actions.gap: Prove discovery, listing, decisions, inspections, and later HomeID continuity.

actions.action: Capture a guided property inspection
actions.statusReason: Inspection and property record anchors exist without current role-eligible production proof.
actions.gap: Prove guided capture, report access, repair handoff, and ownership decisions.

actions.action: Order and track materials
actions.statusReason: Supply Run surfaces exist without a timestamped production order-to-proof journey.
actions.gap: Prove order creation, fulfillment handoff, status, and delivery proof.

actions.action: Save something for later
actions.statusReason: Saved-item routes and Exchange surfaces exist without current cross-surface persistence proof.
actions.gap: Prove listings, offers, projects, and ideas can be saved and reopened accurately.

actions.action: Write down what matters
actions.statusReason: A notes route exists without proof that notes remain attached to the promised people, jobs, purchases, and decisions.
actions.gap: Prove contextual attachment and retrieval rather than an isolated note page.

actions.action: Request access to or deletion of account data
actions.statusReason: A privacy-request surface exists without timestamped production handling proof.
actions.gap: Prove intake, identity verification, retained-record boundaries, and terminal response.

actions.action: Review the rules that govern an action
actions.statusReason: Policy and compliance routes exist without proof that each governed action presents the correct current rules contextually.
actions.gap: Map action-specific policies and verify they are reachable beside the work they govern.

actions.action: Publish one business home
actions.statusReason: Business profiles are implemented, but no general production proof packet covers offer, service area, proof, requests, and next actions together.
actions.gap: Prove one representative live business home end to end.

actions.action: Point your existing domain to it
actions.statusReason: Custom-domain implementation exists, but current incident work shows production behavior still requires controlled verification.
actions.gap: Prove DNS, TLS, routing, offline fallback, owner access, editing, and sharing on a live custom domain.

actions.action: Carry over useful outside evidence
actions.statusReason: Selective Inheritance is defined and used in profile work without a complete cross-source production proof standard in this contract.
actions.gap: Prove sourced facts, media, records, observation dates, unsupported-claim rejection, and owner review.

actions.action: Use tools built for the business category
actions.statusReason: The About copy says category workflows are rolling out, so availability is not universal.
actions.gap: Publish an explicit category support matrix and prove each advertised workflow.

actions.action: Work from a role-specific workspace
actions.statusReason: Role-specific routes exist, but supported roles and complete workflows are not production-proven here.
actions.gap: Prove role authority, navigation, data ownership, and terminal work outcomes per supported role.

actions.action: Manage clients, jobs, and financial records
actions.statusReason: Business dashboard and accounting flows exist, but current system review identifies separate lifecycle islands.
actions.gap: Link accepted cases deterministically to customers, jobs, expenses, materials, vendors, payroll, and records.

actions.action: Keep an accounting trail
actions.statusReason: Ledger and accounting contract coverage exists without a timestamped production reconciliation.
actions.gap: Prove revenue, expenses, transaction history, categories, and case linkage reconcile.

actions.action: Create estimates and invoices
actions.statusReason: Estimate and invoice machinery exists without a current production golden case tied to the originating request.
actions.gap: Prove customer document creation, delivery, payment progress, and request or job continuity.

actions.action: Manage relationships and follow-ups
actions.statusReason: CRM, Direct Connect, and business operations exist as partially separate data islands.
actions.gap: Unify contact, opportunity, conversation, assignment, job, and next-step identity.

actions.action: Review work that fits before accepting it
actions.statusReason: Admins and superadmins do not yet have the required global delegated-operator queue and reply authority.
actions.gap: Provide business, admin, and superadmin visibility plus assign, route, assist, and audited business-branded reply.

actions.action: Find and bid on commercial work
actions.statusReason: Commercial directory implementation exists without current production proof of document access, eligibility, bid submission, and status.
actions.gap: Prove one verified-business commercial bid journey.

actions.action: Understand business performance
actions.statusReason: Analytics surfaces exist without reconciled production proof across requests, attention, value, outcomes, and revenue.
actions.gap: Define authoritative metrics and reconcile them to operating records.

actions.action: Operate a vehicle-sales workflow
actions.statusReason: The About copy qualifies these tools by availability, and no complete production vehicle-sales journey is recorded here.
actions.gap: Prove listings, VIN data, follow-up, finance factors, estimates, trade-in, appointments, and conversations.

actions.action: Operate a property-sales workflow
actions.statusReason: The About copy limits these tools to approved roles, and no complete production property-sales journey is attached.
actions.gap: Prove role approval, listing, clients, analysis, appointments, inspection follow-up, and HomeID continuity.

actions.action: Build local discovery from maintained information
actions.statusReason: Maintained profile and discovery surfaces exist without a current proof that all channels consume one authoritative business identity.
actions.gap: Prove profile updates flow to public discovery and sharing without duplicate manual truth.

actions.action: Learn a tool before depending on it
actions.statusReason: The About copy explicitly says guidance coverage varies by tool.
actions.gap: Publish a coverage registry linking each operational tool to current guidance and ownership.

actions.action: Apply for business support when a program is open
actions.statusReason: The public copy makes this action conditional on a named program being open, with published terms and selection rules.
actions.gap: Record an actual open program, terms, availability, selection process, and application outcome before upgrading status.

actions.action: Write and save the business story
actions.statusReason: A Story Generator surface exists without timestamped production proof for create, save, copy, publish, and remove.
actions.gap: Prove all advertised story lifecycle actions on one business.

actions.action: Publish an offer without buying trust
actions.statusReason: Promotion and trust implementation anchors exist without a production proof that paid visibility remains separate from CVS and organic order.
actions.gap: Prove promotion creation, labeling, eligibility, and no-trust-purchase invariants.

actions.action: Publish once and extend it outside TradeScout
actions.statusReason: The About copy states the management area exists while dependable end-to-end automatic publishing is still expanding by platform.
actions.gap: Prove explicit account authorization, content choice, destination choice, delivery result, and failure visibility per platform.

actions.action: Track money moving through the account
actions.statusReason: Wallet and payment implementation anchors exist without a reconciled production balance-and-history proof.
actions.gap: Prove balance, transaction history, source activity, reversals, and terminal payment state.

actions.action: Share without losing referral credit
actions.statusReason: Affiliate and sharing routes exist without timestamped production proof from signed-in share through qualifying revenue.
actions.gap: Prove attribution persistence, qualification, payout rules, and non-qualifying outcomes.

actions.action: Have TradeScout build the branded profile
actions.statusReason: Hands-on profile delivery exists as an operating service without a general production service-level and acceptance proof in this registry.
actions.gap: Prove intake, source review, owner review, publication, and separation from trust, rank, request, or contact access.

actions.action: Order branded products or marketing help
actions.statusReason: A ScoutFitters route is advertised without a timestamped production order or service-delivery proof in this contract.
actions.gap: Prove product or service selection, request or order, payment where applicable, fulfillment, and terminal outcome.

goldenJourneys.name: JW Stone catalog inquiry
goldenJourneys.purpose: Prove a current, evidence-safe catalog item can become a TradeScout-managed sale without exposing direct contact or losing operator, conversation, delivery, quote, and outcome continuity.

stages.name: Discover the maintained business catalog
stages.statusReason: A single request-only JW Stone Exchange spotlight now leads to the maintained current-inventory profile catalog, but it has no production journey proof and old-site-only additions do not yet have product-numbered sheet evidence.
stages.gap: Prove the spotlight reaches the maintained catalog, then admit each old-site-only slab or bundle only after it has a stable product number, confirmed sheet row, and matched image filenames.

stages.name: Prepare and submit an item-specific inquiry
stages.statusReason: The item-specific Express Direct Connect path has implementation and historical audit evidence, but no current timestamped golden-case proof.
stages.gap: Prove the selected catalog item and approved context survive draft, authentication, submission, and queue entry.

stages.name: Enter the global TradeScout operator queue
stages.statusReason: Admins and superadmins do not yet have global delegated-business visibility and complete route, assign, assist, or reply authority.
stages.gap: Implement the global queue with immutable acted-by and acting-as audit fields.

stages.name: Reply in the correct business-branded case conversation
stages.statusReason: Conversation identity and delegated business reply are not yet reliably tied to the exact request and assignment.
stages.gap: Require one conversation per case and assignment while retaining the internal acting administrator.

stages.name: Record in-app and operational email delivery truth
stages.statusReason: No durable email attempt or result was recorded for the observed JW Stone request.
stages.gap: Persist recipient resolution and queued, sent, delivered, failed, or suppressed outcomes.

stages.name: Carry the inquiry into quote, order, and terminal outcome
stages.statusReason: Direct Connect, quoting, ordering, finance, and outcome records remain insufficiently unified for this sale journey.
stages.gap: Retain one case identity from inquiry through quote or explicit no-sale outcome.

goldenJourneys.name: Service business lifecycle
goldenJourneys.purpose: Prove a local service need moves from discovery through selected-business acceptance, conversation, customer and job records, estimate, schedule, invoice or receipt, outcome, and future HomeID or CVS context.

stages.name: Discover a business and prepare the need
stages.statusReason: Scout, Decision Card, and profile surfaces exist without a current full-journey production artifact.
stages.gap: Prove context survives discovery, comparison, and preparation.

stages.name: Submit to a selected business and record acceptance
stages.statusReason: Request and assignment machinery exists, but selected-recipient, business, and operator visibility are not proven together.
stages.gap: Prove requester choice, business preview, acceptance or decline, and delegated-operator access.

stages.name: Open one case-specific conversation
stages.statusReason: Message, notification, and request identifiers do not yet form one dependable case-specific communication spine.
stages.gap: Canonicalize conversation, notification destination, and delivery truth around the case and assignment.

stages.name: Create or link the customer and job
stages.statusReason: Business and job records exist, but deterministic accepted-case linkage is not production-proven.
stages.gap: Require every converted case to link to one customer and one job or explicit non-job outcome.

stages.name: Estimate, schedule, invoice, and record payment state
stages.statusReason: The component capabilities exist, but their shared case continuity and production reconciliation are not proven.
stages.gap: Carry the same case through estimate, schedule, invoice or receipt, payment state, and ledger.

stages.name: Close the outcome and improve future context
stages.statusReason: No current golden case proves a terminal service outcome returns to HomeID and CVS without unsupported claims.
stages.gap: Record terminal outcome or reason, attach verified property history where applicable, and recompute only supported trust signals.

stages.name: Allow TradeScout operators to recover any stalled stage
stages.statusReason: Global delegated operation, business-branded assistance, and exact delivery visibility are not complete.
stages.gap: Give admin and superadmin a truthful global queue, controlled actions, and immutable operator audit history.
